title: Semicolon, V, W and hyphen
summary: Two new keys: semicolon, V, W and hyphen. The finger goes out, presses, and comes back.
intro: Two new keys in this lesson: semicolon, V, W and hyphen. They belong to your left little finger, your right ring finger, your right middle finger and your right little finger. The movement is always the same — out, press, back — and the way back is the part being trained, because a finger left out of place spoils the next letter.
congrats: Two more keys under your fingers. If semicolon, V, W and hyphen already come without searching, the lesson has done its job.
